title: Institute of Metal Research, Chinese Academy of Sciences
content:
The Institute of Metal Research (IMR), Chinese Academy of Sciences, founded in 1953 in Shenyang, is a leading Chinese institute for metals and advanced structural and functional materials and hosts the Shenyang National Laboratory for Materials Science, working with aerospace, energy, and manufacturing sectors.

Its aerogel-related research includes boron nitride aerogels with varied superstructures developed by the group of Prof. Jingyang Wang, graphene-based cellular materials and carbon nanotube arrays from the Shenyang National Laboratory for Materials Science, and patented carbon aerogel/ceramic layered composites integrating heat insulation with load-bearing capacity for service up to about 1800 °C, aimed at ultrahigh-temperature thermal protection in aerospace.
